item.text:
Implemented `summarizeSales(csv)` in [src/summarize.js](C:\Users\bash\AppData\Local\Temp\offcut-bench-work-j68BZG\repo\src\summarize.js).

It now:

- Parses quoted regions containing commas and escaped quotes.
- Sums numeric amounts by region.
- Handles LF and CRLF input.
- Ignores blank rows.
- Throws `TypeError` for non-finite amounts.
- Safely supports special region names such as `__proto__`.
